public_note: This Noether Paper 32 package is a compact IA source/provenance witness for printed pp.221-228, not a corrected TeX branch.

files.quality_label: Noether Paper 32 IA source witness / provenance package
files.coverage: Paper 32 source span for Emmy Noether with Richard Brauer, Über minimale Zerfällungskörper irreduzibler Darstellungen, from Sitzungsberichte der Preussischen Akademie der Wissenschaften, 1927, printed/source pp.221-228. The package includes the IA source PDF, IA scandata XML, two IA OCR/DJVU text witnesses, the pp.221-228 leaf map, and extracted JP2 plus JPG witnesses for IA leaves 0382-0389.
files.findings: The source-master folder contained a full 685 MB IA JP2 volume ZIP plus extracted Paper 32 leaves. The queued package deliberately keeps only the compact, relevant source witness subset and preserves OCR as a locator aid only.
files.limitations: Source/provenance support only. It is not a corrected TeX branch, translation, full Paper 32 certification, critical edition, or multilingual propagation. Source page images control readings; OCR text is not textual authority.
files.next_action: Upload with the next Noether source-audit/provenance Zenodo version if preserving the Paper 32 IA source witness subset is desired, then update record IDs, metadata JSON, public catalog, generated record pages, and status docs. Use this as a checking aid for later Paper 32 source repair/reconciliation.
